summary: An all-in-one audio and video editing tool that includes features like transcription, screen recording, and multitrack editing.
description:
An all-in-one audio and video editing tool that includes features like transcription, screen recording, and multitrack editing.

Descript is the AI video and audio editor that makes editing as easy as editing text. Record, transcribe, edit, and publish in one tool. Try it free.

Overdub: AI-powered voice cloning for seamless edits. Studio Sound: Enhances audio quality by removing noise and echo. Text-Based Editing: Edit audio and video by editing the transcribed text. Multi-Track Editing: Supports editing multiple audio and video tracks simultaneously.
